confirmedFindings: The reported visual defect is represented by the default NightCityRenderer path, not by a sibling or debug-only scene.
The current renderer treats full-frame opaque panoramas as independent tiles and adds only a low-alpha generic mist at each join.
A successful repair needs a deterministic, authored transition asset or generated raster band that owns the join instead of merely covering it.
remainingGaps: The exact transition asset recipe and its runtime memory budget still need implementation and natural-input verification.
